objective: Execute RISC-V RV32I communication protocols algorithm 3.
theory: RISC-V is an open-standard ISA based on established RISC principles. RV32I is the base 32-bit integer instruction set with 32 general registers (x0-x31).
algorithm: 1. Load 32-bit word from memory address in register x12 into x10.
2. Add immediate integer 3 to x10 into x11 (ADDI).
3. Store 32-bit word from x11 into memory address [x12 + 4].
flowchart: START -> Execute Communication Protocols Step 1 -> Process Data -> Verify Flags/Result -> END
assembly_code:
# RISC-V RV32I Assembly - Communication Protocols Ex 3
lw x10, 0(x12)
addi x11, x10, 3
sw x11, 4(x12)

step_by_step_execution: Step 1: Fetch and decode Communication Protocols instruction for RISC-V (RV32I).
Step 2: Read input operands from memory / registers.
Step 3: Execute ALU operation for Communication Protocols.
Step 4: Update status flags (Z, CY, S, P).
Step 5: Store final result into memory.
explanation: This program demonstrates communication protocols on the RISC-V (RV32I) architecture.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to clear carry or flags before loop.
